s: Din meqom hanachatan veopen hanachatan ubo k"d seipim: meqom hanachat tepillin shel yad — beyad semolo, shenneemar: "al yodka", vedareshu raza"l: yad keha, dehaynu yad semol shehi tashsha vekeha:

Tzarik lahanichah begobah habbasar shebbepereq hazzeroa shebben hammarpeq (sheqqorin "aolamabogin" bilshon ashkenaz) lehakkatep, vezeh hammaqom niqra qibboret. Abal lo yenichenna lemala mehaqqibboret, dehaynu shello yenichenna lemala mechatzi happereq shebben hammarpeq lakkatep. Vaapillu bachatzi hattachton shel zeh happereq — lo yaniach betachtito mammash lematta mehaqqibboret, shenneemar: "vesamtem et debaray elleh vego'" — tzerika shettehe sima keneged halleb, vezehu qibboret, shehu mekuvvan mammash keneged halleb. Laken tzarik sheyyatteh et hattepillin shel yad letzad haggup meat, beinyan shekkesheyyakop hazzeroa lematta — tehe hattepillin shel yad mekuvvan keneged libbo mammash:

Mi shenniqtea yado hassemalit lemala min haqqibboret — en tzarik lehaniach tepillin bimino. Abal im niqtea lematta min haqqibboret — yesh omerim dechayyab lehaniach tepillin shel yad al haqqibboret (shel semol) (vehammagen abraham pasaq shel yemino). Veyesh omerim kevan sheomra tora: "al yadeka", lemala min hayyad, dehaynu qibboret, vezeh en lo yad, laken hu patur min hattepillin shel yad. Uleinyan halaka yesh lehachamir bedibre tora, velaken yaniach belo beraka:
Minhag yapeh venakon sheyyehe hayyu"d shel haqqesher tepillin shel yad noteh letzad halleb, vehattepillin shel yad alayv letzad chutz:
Yesh lizzaher shello tazuz hayyu"d shel haqqesher mehattepilla, mehattaam shennitbaer bazzohar:
Minhag nakon lehaniach tepillin shel yad beinyan shehammabarta shebbah oberet haretzua tehe munachat letzad hakkatep vehaqqetzitza letzad hayyad:

Yesh omerim shetztzarik shello yehe dabar chotzetz ben hattepillin libsaro, shenneemar: "al yadeka", mashma al yado mammash belo chatzitza benetayim. Vehu haddin bitpillin shel rosh tzarik lizzaher baddabar shello yehe shum dabar chotzetz ben tepillin lisaro. Veapar o kinna meta — niqra chatzitza. Velaken yesh nohagin lirchotz meqom hanachat tepillin shel rosh. Veken baretzuot, mah sheshshayyak lehaqqeshira, dehaynu mah shemmaqqip et hayyad paam achat umah shemmaqqip et harosh — tzarik lizzaher shello yihyeh sham shum chatzitza. Veyesh omerim sheen tzarik lizzaher kelal shello yehe dabar chotzetz ben tepillin libsaro o lisaro. Veap-al-pi sheen halaka kedibrehem, mikkol maqom adam shehu alul linzilut velo yakol legallot rosho shello yazziq lo haqqerirut, veim nechayyeb oto lehaniach tepillin shel rosh al rosho mammash beli chatzitza — lo yukal lehanichah kelal, veyitbattel mimmitzvat tepillin al yede zeh, laken mutab shennattir lo lismok al sebara acharona , veyaniach tepillin shel rosh al koba daq hassamuk larosh, velo yebarek aleha. Abal al koba abeh — asur lahanichah, mippene shetztzarik lehaniach tepillin shel rosh keneged maqom shemmoach shel tinoq ropes kemo sheyyitbaer, vehammeniach al gabbe koba abeh — eno menicho neged hammaqom shemmocho shel tinoq ropes. Vaapillu hammeniach al gabbe koba daq — tzarik hu lekassot et hattepilla shel rosh mippene haroim, shello yilmedu laasot ken apillu belo ones gadol:

Im yesh leadam makka bimqom hanachat tepillin shel yad — ap-al-pi-ken yaniach tepillin shel yad shello al hammakka, ki maqom yesh baqqibboret lehaniach shene tepillin. Veim hammakka al kol haqqibboret umitztaer lahanichah al gabbe hammakka — patur mittepillin shel yad, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman lach. Umikkol maqom, im epshar — yaniach semartutin al hammakka veyaniach hattepillin shel yad alehem belo beraka, o yaniach al habbeged belo beraka, raq sheyyizzaher lekassot et hattepillin shel yad, shello tehe niret, shenneemar: "vehaya leka leot" — "leka leot", velo laacherim leot. Bammeh debarim amurim shetztzarik lekassotah? Keshemmenichah al dabar sheen darko lihyot leolam mekusseh, kegon beged o semartutin, abal im menichah al besaro mammash — en tzarik lekassotah, apillu im niqra chaluqo vekol begadayv bemaqom shekkeneged tepillin shel yad. Veap-al-pi shenniret laacherim — en bekak kelum, shello hiqpida tora shettehe hattepillin shel yad mekussa davqa, ella apillu im hi niret, raq shettehe munachat bemaqom sheddarko lihyot tamid mekusseh, dehaynu qibboret:

Itter yad yemino, im oseh kol melakto bismolo — yaniach tepillin shel yad bismolo, shehi yamin shel kol adam. Vaapillu oseh kol maasayv beyamin shel kol adam, ella shekkoteb bismolo — yaniach tepillin shel yad bismolo shehi yamin shel kol adam, shenneemar: "uqeshartam", "uketabtam", mah ketiba beyamin — ap qeshira beyamin, umiddiqshira beyamin mikkelal dahanachat tepillin shel yad al semol, dibyad shehu koteb bah — tzarik liqshor et hattepillin shel yad al hayyad shekkenegdo. Abal im koteb beyamin shel kol adam, ap-al-pi sheshshear kol maasayv oseh bismol shel kol adam, vaapillu hu koteb gam ken bismol kol adam, kevan dekoteb gam ken beyamin shel kol adam — (bah hu) tzarik liqshor et hattepillin shel yad al hayyad shekkenegdah. Veen tzarik lomar, im hu sholet bishte yadayv beshaveh, shehu meniach al semol shel kol adam:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshennolad itter yad, abal im achar-kak hirgil et atzmo liktob bismolo, ushear kol maasayv oseh beyamin — en dino keitter, ella meniach al semol kol adam, shehare hi yad keha shello. Abal im hirgil et atzmo laasot kol maasayv bismol — yaniach al yemin kol adam, shehare hi yad keha shello:
Shiur orek retzua shel tepillin shel yad — kede shettaqqip et hazzeroa veyiqshor mimmenna et haqqesher vetimmatach retzua achat ad etzba emtzait veyikrok mimmenna al etzbao shalosh kerikot veyiqshor:
Nohagin likrok sebib happereq shebben hayyad lehammarpeq sheba kerikot. Veyesh likrok bappereq hattachton shel haetzba haemtzai shette kerikot upereq haelyon kerika achat:

En likrok haretzua al hattittura kede lechazzeqah ulehaddeqah al hayyad, ella tehe hattepillin shel yad teluya umunachat al haqqibboret keen tepillin shel rosh al harosh, kevan sheen mitzva kelal bikrika zo, laken en lahanichah al hattittura sheyyesh bah qedushsha yoter min haretzua:

"Ben eneka" haamur bitpillin shel rosh — zehu gobah shebbarosh, o eno ella "ben eneka" mammash? Neemar kan "ben eneka" veneemar lehallan "lo tasimu qorcha ben enekem", mah lehallan begobah shebbarosh bemaqom sheoseh qorcha — ap kan begobah shebbarosh maqom sheoseh qorcha. Vetzarik lihyot kol hattepillin bemaqom sheoseh qorcha, dehaynu sheqqatzeh hattachton shel hattittura yihyeh munach al meqom hatchalat iqqere hassear bemitzcho. Venimshak hammaqom harauy lihyot tepillin shel rosh ad sop maqom shemmocho shel tinoq ropes, dehaynu shehaqqatzeh haelyon shel hattepilla lo yihyeh munach lemala mimmaqom shemmocho shel tinoq ropes:
Tzarik sheyyihyeh haqqesher shel tepillin shel rosh meachore harosh lemala begobah haorep shehu sop haggulgolet, vehu keneged happanim:
Tzarik sheyyihyeh haqqesher beemtza haorep, velo yitteh lekan o lekan:
Vetzarik sheyyehe hammaqom shebbaqqesher shennira keen dale"t letzad chutz, velo kelappe haorep. Vehu haddin beqesher tepillin shel yad — tzarik lizzaher shello yithappek:
Tzarik lekavven haqqetzitza shettehe beemtza rochab harosh, kede shettehe keneged ben haenayim (velaken tob sheyyehe haqqesher shel tepillin shel rosh baggobah):

Tzarik sheyyehe tzad hashshachor shebbaretzuot letzad chutz, velo yithappeku haretzuot ben bitpillin shel yad ben bitpillin shel rosh. Veim nithappeku beshogeg — middat chasidut lehitannot. Veen lehaqpid shello yithappeku ella mah shemmaqqip et harosh veet haqqibboret paam achat, abal mah shekkorek achar-kak, veken mah shemmishtalshel lepanayv meharetzua shel tepillin shel rosh — en tzarik lehaqpid kelal shello yithappek, lepi sheenan meiqqar hammitzva:

Yeshalshel haretzuot shel tepillin shel rosh veyihyu teluyim millepanayv, veqibbelu haggeonim shetztzarik sheyyaggiu ad hattabbur o lemala mimmennu meat. Verochab haretzuot shel tepillin shel yad utepillin shel rosh — qibbelu haggeonim sheyyehe keorek seora lepachot:

Im pachat mishshiur orek retzua shel tepillin shel rosh, veken im pachat mishshiur rochab haretzuot ben tepillin shel yad uben tepillin shel rosh, im eno motze retzuot acherot — menichan kemot shehen, mippene shekkol hashshiurim hallalu lo nizkeru baggemara:
Abal im en baretzuot shel tepillin shel rosh beorkan kede sheyyihyu meshulshalin lepanayv apillu meat — pesulin, mippene shezzeh nizkar baggemara:

Tepillin shel rosh tob lihyotam geluyim venirim, kemo shenneemar: "verau kol amme haaretz ki shem Hashem niqra aleka", vedareshu raza"l: ellu tepillin shebbarosh. Velaken yesh lizzaher shello lekassot legamre et hattepillin shel rosh battallit gadol, raq shettehe megulla qetzat:

Abal talmid bipne rabbo — en derek eretz legallot hattepillin shel rosh bepanayv, shello yashveh atzmo lerabbo venireh keazzut panim, shehattepillin hen derek kabod, kemo sheamar hakkatub: "verau kol vego'". Bammeh debarim amurim? Shellobesh tepillin kol hayyom shello bishat qeriat shema utepilla, deaz mecheze keyohara im megalleh otan bipne rabbo, kevan derob haolam en nohagin lehaniach tepillin kol hayyom, abal bishat qeriat shema utepilla, kevan dehakkol menichin tepillin az — en kan yohara kelal, umuttar legallotan bipne rabbo:
